title: Man Realizes Cops Know He Hid His Girlfriend's Dead Body
description:
Bodycam footage shows Cleveland police confronting the boyfriend of a slain woman in 2024. Ohio police suspected James Drahos dumped Tammy Dubuisson's body inside a dumpster at a nearby Elementary school after an incident in their driveway. Get the full story of the James Drahos case on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
